purpose: Provide an opt-in fail-closed step wrapper that blocks invalid constraints or locally provable projected-translation conflicts before donor integration, while delegating accepted inputs unchanged to the existing seven-family constraint composer.

properties.options.preflight: options forwarded only to the conservative constraint preflight
properties.options.composer: options forwarded only to the existing seven-family constraint composer

limitations: opt-in wrapper only; existing composer behavior is not changed
blocks invalid composer input and only conflicts proven by the conservative projected-translation preflight
distance joints and distance limits remain outside the local conflict proof and are delegated when otherwise valid
successful preflight is not proof of global satisfiability, convergence, stability or physical correctness
accepted paths retain the existing deterministic family order, bounded-pass behavior and contact-evidence boundaries
does not alter the imported donor physics source

proves: provable local projected conflicts are blocked before donor integration
invalid full-composer constraints are blocked before donor integration
blocked paths preserve caller world state and checksum
accepted paths are byte-for-byte world-equivalent to direct composer delegation for the same inputs and options
valid distance constraints outside the preflight proof are delegated rather than misclassified as conflicts
blocked decision evidence replays deterministically in one JS runtime

truth.basis: The guard blocks only invalid input or contradictions already proven by the conservative preflight; unsupported nonlinear families stay explicit non-claims.

agency.basis: The wrapper is opt-in and returns explicit block evidence without mutating constraints or silently changing the existing composer.

continuity.basis: Accepted work delegates to the existing composer unchanged and leaves the byte-for-byte donor source untouched.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Known-invalid or locally contradictory work is rejected before spending a donor integration step while valid work follows the established path.
